excerpt.zh:
我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经完成了对这种在[This.System.GetName]恒星系发现的非凡的、自由漂浮的晶态物体的调查报告。他们的发现令人震惊。

这些飞船般大小的物体以及它们的较小型的晶体卫星初看之下是无生命迹象的，然而一旦我们飞船靠近，它们就会突然改变方向并且从晶体内散发出能源波动，这说明它们也许是以生命形式存在的——这样的现象毫无疑问令人好奇，但我们得要小心处理。

我们最杰出且聪敏的科学家们都准备好研究这些实体了。

texts.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished investigating the reports of extraordinary, free-floating crystal-like objects observed in the [This.System.GetName] system. Their findings are startling.

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they might be alive - a fascinating prospect to be sure, but they should be approached with caution.

Our best and brightest are standing by to study these entities.

我们最好派遣一支舰队试探这些晶体的侵略性，如果发现有威胁就把它们摧毁掉。

We should deploy a fleet to gauge the crystals' offensive strength, should they possess any, and destroy them if they are a threat.

texts.en:
Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished investigating the reports of extraordinary, free-floating crystal-like objects observed in the [This.System.GetName] system. Their findings are startling.

The ship-size objects and their slightly smaller but equally crystal-like satellites at first appeared inert, but sudden shifts in their orientation relative to our ships and new energy signatures emerging from within the prisms indicate that they should be regarded as hazardous and approached with caution.

We can either attempt to engage with the potentially dangerous objects directly, or establish remote surveillance and observe them from a safe distance.

texts.zh: 我们不确定这些生物是否进食，只要他们吃东西就可以当做我们种子的携带者。安抚他们可以让我们进行进一步的研究。
texts.en: We're unsure these creatures are capable of eating, but if so, they could prove useful carrier for our seeds. Pacifying them would allow us to conduct further studies.

texts.zh: 这些生物似乎通过折射光线的色度变化来相互交流。虽然这种媒介具有表达复杂信息的巨大潜力，但这些半智慧生命体只以基本的方式使用它。颜色的变化可以用来表示社会地位、攻击性，甚至生育状况。
texts.en: These creatures seem to communicate with one another via chromatic changes in refracted light. While this medium has high potential for complex expressions, it is only utilized in a basic manner by these semi-sentient lifeforms. Changes in color can be used to indicate social status, aggression, and even fertility conditions.

texts.zh:
晶态实体很可能是活的。

或许称它们为“硅酸活体物质”更为恰当，因为它们与常见的生物或是传统人造生命大相径庭。

这些实体似乎并不繁殖，并且我们所观察到的晶体在年龄上似乎都没有什么差别。与一个早期假设相反的是，晶态实体个体所发生的色调转变似乎与其年龄无关，而是受其潜在的内部电荷影响——而且可以被猛烈地释放——而偶尔产生的能源波动会改变晶体的折射特性。
texts.en:
The Crystalline Entities are probably alive.

A perhaps more descriptive name for them is "silicate-animate matter," as they have little in common with biological or traditionally artificial life.

The Entities do not seem to mate, and we have yet to observe any Crystals that are recognizably older or younger than others. Contrary to an early hypothesis, the shifts in hue between individual Crystalline Entities seem to be related not to their age but to their latent internal charge - which can be violently unleashed - and it appear as if though sporadic fluctuations in this charge alter the refractive properties of the Crystal.

texts.zh:
晶态实体——这是[Root.Capital.GetName]的外星生物学家跟外星地质学家互相妥协后所决定的名字——它们确实是生命体。

一部分过于保守的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]学术精英认为它们是“硅酸盐活性物质”，跟生命体没什么共同之处。

[Root.GetName]的大部分民众不认同这种观点，而是开始赞叹这种晶态实体所代表的新概念。它们是一种单独生活的生物，每一个母体结晶通常只会带着一个哨兵以及一小队晶体军团。除了明显服从领袖命令的哨兵和军团之外，我们对于晶态实体的社会分层是一无所知——这个课题在[Root.Capital.GetName]引发了一场热烈探讨。

晶体似乎不会繁殖，而且我们还没有发现它们的个体之间有明显的年龄差别。跟早前的推论不同，晶体的不同颜色与它们的年龄无关，而是受到内部的潜在变化而改变——而这种变化可以被释放出来——这种偶尔的波动会改变晶体的反射属性。
texts.en:
The Crystalline Entities - the name itself a compromise between rival factions of xeno-biologists and xeno-geologists on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are most definitely alive.

Some overly-conservative members of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] academic elite argue that they are "silicate-animate matter," and that they have little in common with biological life.

Most of the [Root.GetName] populace rejects that regressive perspective, instead turning their view toward the fascinating new horizons that the Crystalline Entities represent. They are, somewhat regrettably, solitary beings, each individual Crystal Sovereign rarely seen with more than one Sentinel and a smaller Cohort entity. Aside from the Cohort and Sentinel clearly being subservient to the Sovereign of the group, the subtle nuances of the Crystalline Entities' socio-hierarchical relationships are lost on us - which does not stop these dynamics from being the subject of fevered study on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The Entities do not seem to mate, and we have yet to observe any Crystals that are recognizably older or younger than others. Contrary to an early hypothesis, the shifts in hue between individual Crystalline Entities seem to be related not to their age but to their latent internal charge - which can be violently unleashed - and it appear as if though sporadic fluctuations in this charge alter the refractive properties of the Crystal.

texts.zh:
晶态实体——这是[Root.Capital.GetName]的外星生物学家跟外星地质学家互相妥协后所确定的名字——它们似乎真的是生命体。

早期分析给它们起的名字是活体硅酸物质，因为它们跟生命体没什么共同之处。它们是一种单独生活的生物，每一个母体结晶通常只会带着一个哨兵以及一小队晶体军团。除了明显服从领袖命令的哨兵和军团之外，我们对于晶态实体的社会分层可以说是一无所知。

晶体似乎不会繁殖，而且我们还没有发现它们的个体之间有明显的年龄差别。跟早前的推论不同，晶体的不同颜色与它们的年龄无关，而是受到内部的潜在变化而改变——而这种变化可以被释放出来——这种偶尔的波动会改变晶体的反射属性。晶态实体可以对指定的目标释放这种波动，而且很不幸的，它们似乎热衷于对任何靠近的陌生种群如此做。
texts.en:
The Crystalline Entities - the name itself a compromise between rival factions of xeno-biologists and xeno-geologists on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are probably alive.

An earlier and perhaps more descriptive name for them was "silicate-animate matter," as they have little in common with biological life. They are solitary beings, each individual Crystal Sovereign rarely seen with more than a Sentinel and a smaller Cohort entity. Aside from the Cohort and Sentinel clearly being subservient to the Sovereign of the group, the subtle nuances of the Crystalline Entities' socio-hierarchical relationships are lost on us.

The Entities do not seem to mate, and we have yet to observe any Crystals that are recognizably older or younger than others. Contrary to an early hypothesis, the shifts in hue between individual Crystalline Entities seem to be related not to their age but to their latent internal charge, and it appears as if though sporadic fluctuations in this charge alter the refractive properties of the Crystal. The Crystalline Entities are capable of violently discharging at specific target, and unfortunately seem to prefer to do so rather than let foreign entities pass by unscathed.

label.zh: 听上去好像以后可能派上用场。
在战斗方面上有什么利用方法？

texts.zh: 晶态实体似乎会对特定的频率共振，这也是他们与环境之间少有的互动。发出电波的特性与目的目前尚未明确，但目前我们的舰船可以使用无线电进行模仿，并将自己伪装成晶态实体。
texts.en: The Crystalline Entities seem to resonate in response to something; one of their few interactions with their environment. The exact nature and possible wider purpose of this emitted waveform has yet to be ascertained, but for now our ships can approximate it using radio pings, essentially camouflaging themselves as fellow Crystals.

texts.zh: 为这些生物培育美味的果实颇具挑战。我们还不确定它们是在吃我们创造的玻璃状的球果，还是只是因为被其光滑的表面所吸引而随身携带。无论如何这都能满足我们的需求了。
texts.en: Developing a palatable fruit for these creatures has been a challenge. We're not sure if they're eating the glass-like pomes we created or if they just like to carry them around, enamored by their glossy surfaces. That's enough for our needs.

texts.zh: 安排一个科学部门收集并整理晶态实体的相关数据。
texts.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Crystalline Entities.

texts.zh: 在某些星系中观察到的晶态实体处于不稳定状态，也许会造成危险。
texts.en: The Crystalline Entities observed in some systems are volatile and potentially dangerous.
